question: What rejuvenating transformation results from six months of dedicated practice?
premises: The practice is performed for six months
It is done repeatedly and devotedly
Even an old person becomes youthful
inference: Six months of devoted practice makes even an old person youthful.
uncertainties: The form taruṇā āyate is morphologically unusual and may reflect textual variation
plain_english: Through six months of devoted, repeated practice, even an old person becomes youthful.
